axe.lore.rare: Splits anything it is pointed at, so the grown-ups keep it locked in the shed and point it only at logs.
axe.lore.legendary: Split one log so cleanly that the two halves are still standing up in the woodshed, too surprised to fall over.

x_exercise_bike.lore.uncommon: Has a little screen showing a beautiful mountain road that freezes on the same cow every time.

broom.lore.epic: Swept the street so fast on spring cleaning day that the cat, two pigeons and a parked bike ended up in one neat pile.
broom.lore.legendary: Swept so hard one windy day that it took off, did a lap of the garden and landed in next door's cauliflowers.

x_oil_can.lore.rare: Oils things so well that the whole house goes silent, and nobody can hear anyone sneaking to the biscuit tin any more.
x_oil_can.lore.epic: Oiled every chain in the school bike shed, and the bikes rode off so fast that the children had to run after them.
x_oil_can.lore.legendary: Oiled the stiff hands of the town clock so well that they slid round twice, and the town had two lunchtimes.

x_paint_can.lore.legendary: Painted every front door on the street a different colour, and now the postman delivers by colour and nobody gets the right letters.

dumbbell.lore.epic: Was dropped so hard that the treadmills started by themselves, and two people ran a mile before they noticed.
dumbbell.lore.legendary: Was lifted so often by one grandma that she now carries the shopping, the car and occasionally the neighbour.

hammer.lore.epic: Banged in so many nails in one weekend that the house next door started leaning over to see what was going on.
hammer.lore.legendary: Built a whole treehouse in one afternoon, and the tree liked it so much that it grew a second floor.

x_bicycle_helmet.lore.rare: Bounces off everything, including its rider's own front door. It took a while to get into the house.
x_bicycle_helmet.lore.legendary: Took a tumble so its rider did not have to, then insisted on rolling home by itself. It got there first.

x_swim_cap.lore.legendary: Swam so fast that it got out of the pool before its swimmer and waited on the side with a towel.

i_amphibian.lore.rare: Drives up waterfalls the wrong way, and the salmon have started catching lifts.
i_amphibian.lore.legendary: Drove so far out on one tour that it reached a little island, and the island now has a bus stop.

i_brass.lore.epic: Was polished so brightly that it bounced the sun into the bakery and toasted every loaf in the window.
i_brass.lore.legendary: Reminded one man on its bench to enjoy the view so well that he is still there, and the council has built him a little roof.

i_coil.lore.legendary: Bounced so high off a trampoline that it landed in a passing hot-air balloon, and is now on holiday.

i_hook.lore.legendary: Held up a coat so full of conkers that it lifted the house half an inch, and the doors now close properly for the first time.

i_knot.lore.epic: Tied two shoelaces so well at sports day that the three-legged race became a twelve-legged race.
i_knot.lore.legendary: Tied itself so firmly round a tree that nobody could undo it, so the family moved the tree instead.

i_mortar.lore.epic: Thumped so hard on curry night that the plates danced off the shelf and landed in a neat stack on the table.
i_mortar.lore.legendary: Ground one peppercorn so fine that it seasoned every pot of soup in town for a whole year.

i_pick.lore.uncommon: Leaves a tiny scratch on the guitar every time, and the scratches now spell something nobody can read.
i_pick.lore.rare: Strums so fast that the guitar starts playing songs it was never taught.
i_pick.lore.legendary: Was thrown into the crowd at a big concert, bounced off forty heads and landed back in the guitarist's pocket.

i_plane.lore.rare: Smooths anything it touches, including the cat, which now slides off every sofa in the house.
i_plane.lore.legendary: Shaved a plank so thin that you can read the newspaper through it, and the family uses it as a window.

i_potter_s_wheel.lore.rare: Spins so fast that anything put on it turns into a bowl, including the potter's sandwich.
i_potter_s_wheel.lore.epic: Spun so fast in pottery class that every pot flew off and landed on the shelf, already in a neat row.
i_potter_s_wheel.lore.legendary: Made every mug in the village cafe, all so wonky that the cafe now sells tea by the slosh.

i_reel.lore.rare: Winds in so fast that the fish arrives before it has decided to bite.
i_reel.lore.epic: Snarled its line round a whole riverbank of reeds, and the ducks sat in the tangle all day like a hammock.
i_reel.lore.legendary: Hooked a fish so big that the fish reeled in the angler instead, and they now take turns.

i_slot.lore.common: Rings its bell and flashes its lights at the seagulls, who are not impressed.
i_slot.lore.uncommon: Has been switched off for years but still hums a little tune whenever the pier lights come on.
i_slot.lore.legendary: Was retired to a museum, and still flashes its lights so proudly that the guards wear sunglasses.

i_spindle.lore.epic: Spun so fast at the craft fair that it wound every visitor's scarf into one long woolly rope.

i_swing.lore.epic: Was swung so hard all lunchtime that its creaking drowned out the dinner bell, and nobody went in.
i_swing.lore.legendary: Swings by itself every evening after the park closes, and the park keeper now gives it a push before going home.

i_wing.lore.rare: Waves its flaps so politely that the plane in front always lets it land first.
i_wing.lore.legendary: Flew so smoothly over the sea that a flock of geese tucked in behind it and reached Spain without flapping.

ladder.lore.epic: Was knocked over on painting day and leaned against the wrong house, so next door got their gutter painted instead.
ladder.lore.legendary: Was climbed so high by the window cleaner that he cleaned the clouds too, and the town had a very sunny week.

mop.lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole paddling pool in one go, then wrung itself out over the vegetable patch.

paintbrush.lore.epic: Painted the fence so quickly that it did the gate, the shed and next door's fence before anyone could say stop.

pliers.lore.common: Grabs everything by its slipperiest corner, so screws ping off across the floor.

x_hedge_trimmer.lore.epic: Trimmed the hedge so low that the neighbours on the other side waved hello for the first time in years, and were not pleased.
x_hedge_trimmer.lore.legendary: Trimmed a garden maze so cleverly that the gardener got lost in it and was found three days later by a hedgehog.

x_leaf_blower.lore.epic: Blew so hard on full power that it cleared the leaves, the gravel and next door's garden gnome off the drive.

power_drill.lore.epic: Drilled one hole so deep that it came out in the neighbour's kitchen, and the neighbour hung a picture on the other end.
power_drill.lore.legendary: Built a whole kitchen by itself overnight, and the family woke up to find it had also made breakfast.

saw.lore.common: Sings a wobbly note every time it bends, and the cat leaves the room.
saw.lore.rare: Cuts so fast that the plank does not notice until it is put down, then falls in half with a gasp.
saw.lore.legendary: Sawed through a log as wide as a car and found a family of squirrels inside, who asked it to add a door while it was there.

screwdriver.lore.legendary: Tightened one screw so hard that it came out on the other side of the world, where somebody uses it as a coat hook.

shovel.lore.uncommon: Has a handle just slightly too short, so every gardener walks home bent like a question mark.
shovel.lore.epic: Dug the vegetable patch so deep that it found an old bath, a rusty bike and next door's lost tortoise.

toolbox.lore.common: Rattles so loudly in the car boot that the driver keeps pulling over to check for a flat tyre.
toolbox.lore.legendary: Fixed so many things in the village that the things started breaking on purpose, just to get a visit.

x_medal_ribbon.lore.epic: Got its ribbons tangled at the fun run, so every finisher crossed the line tied together like a giant necklace.

trophy.lore.legendary: Was won so often by one team that it now walks to their clubhouse by itself every spring.

x_whistle_small.lore.epic: Was blown at the zoo, and every flamingo swapped to its other leg at once, then glared.
x_whistle_small.lore.legendary: Blew a note so high that only dogs could hear it, and every dog in the county turned up for a walk.

x_whistle_sport.lore.rare: Blows itself, so every match ends exactly when the home team is winning.
x_whistle_sport.lore.epic: Blew full time so loudly that the pigeons on the stadium roof took off and spelled FULL TIME in the sky.
x_whistle_sport.lore.legendary: Blew full time so firmly that the rain stopped too, and the grass lay down for a well-earned rest.

wheelbarrow.lore.epic: Raced round the garden so fast that the compost jumped out and planted itself in the flowerbed.
wheelbarrow.lore.legendary: Carried every stone for a whole garden wall, then refused to carry anything else because nothing was as important.

wrench.lore.rare: Grips nuts from across the room, so every tap in the house tightens itself when it walks in.
wrench.lore.legendary: Tightened a tap so hard that the river at the bottom of the garden stopped for an afternoon. The ducks walked across.

x_beach_spade.lore.rare: Digs a hole so deep in one go that it fills with sea and grows a tiny tide of its own.

x_bolt.lore.rare: Bolts itself onto anything nearby, so the bench is now bolted to the shed and the shed to the tree.
x_bolt.lore.legendary: Held the old pier together through a storm so wild that the pier bent into a smile and stayed that way.

x_bowling_pin.lore.epic: Fell over so dramatically that the whole bowling alley stood up and clapped, and it took a bow by falling over again.

x_box_cutter.lore.rare: Slits tape so quietly that the parcel does not notice it has been opened, and keeps pretending to be sealed.
x_box_cutter.lore.legendary: Opened a box so gently that the cat asleep inside never woke up, and the whole house move happened around it.

x_bungee_cord.lore.common: Is always one hook too short, so everyone stretches it with gritted teeth and their eyes shut.
x_bungee_cord.lore.legendary: Held the holiday luggage on so tightly that, when the family arrived, the roof came off with it.

x_cable.lore.rare: Plugs itself into anything, so the toaster is charging the cat flap and the lamp is charging grandad's slippers.
x_cable.lore.epic: Was pulled out of the drawer and just kept coming, until its far end turned out to be plugged into the house next door.

x_cable_car.lore.rare: Stops exactly halfway up whenever the view is best, which is usually when someone needs the toilet.
x_cable_car.lore.epic: Carried so many skiers up on the first snowy day that the mountain tipped slightly, and the hut at the top now has a sloping floor.
x_cable_car.lore.legendary: Carried a cow up the mountain by mistake, and the cow liked the view so much that it now has a season ticket.

x_chain.lore.rare: Locks itself round anything left still for a minute, so the picnic table is now chained to the bike.
x_chain.lore.epic: Rattled so loudly down a bumpy farm lane that every dog came out to bark along, and the cows joined the chorus.
x_chain.lore.legendary: Held a bike to a lamp post so well that, when the lamp post was moved for roadworks, the bike went with it.

x_chisel.lore.uncommon: Gets hit by its mallet so often that it has started flinching whenever anyone picks one up.
x_chisel.lore.epic: Carved a whole chess set in one weekend, and the knights keep jumping off the board.
x_chisel.lore.legendary: Carved the park gate with every animal in the forest, and now the real squirrels queue up to be carved too.

x_clamp.lore.rare: Clamps on to anything it is pointed at, so the curtain, a sock and a loaf of bread are all stuck to the bench.
x_clamp.lore.epic: Was used by the whole woodwork class at once, and by home time every bench was clamped into one long table.
x_clamp.lore.legendary: Held a violin while its glue set, and now the violin plays perfectly, but only when someone squeezes it.

x_corkscrew.lore.legendary: Twisted into one cork so stubborn that it pulled out the bottle, the tablecloth and the table in one go.

x_croquet_mallet.lore.legendary: Hit the ball so hard through the first hoop that it went through every hoop in the garden and three in the next one.

x_crowbar.lore.epic: Opened every crate at the museum delivery, and one dinosaur bone walked off to look for its friends.
x_crowbar.lore.legendary: Prised open an old trunk in the attic that held grandma's lost roller skates, and grandma has not been seen indoors since.

x_downpipe.lore.legendary: Gushed so hard in one storm that it shot a trout onto the lawn, and the cat has been waiting by it ever since.

x_elliptical.lore.common: Has two handles that swing back and forth, so whoever walks past gets elbowed.
x_elliptical.lore.epic: Glided so smoothly at the gym that its rider forgot to get off and stayed through the cleaner, the night shift and breakfast.
x_elliptical.lore.legendary: Glided so smoothly that it slid across the gym, out of the door and halfway to the shops with its rider still striding.

x_envelope_opener.lore.common: Opens every letter in the pile except the one marked URGENT, which it always saves for later.
x_envelope_opener.lore.legendary: Opened a letter so neatly that the letter sealed itself again and posted itself back, unopened.

x_fairy_lights.lore.legendary: Twinkled so convincingly that a swarm of fireflies tried to join the string, and one bulb has buzzed ever since.

x_file_tool.lore.rare: Files so smoothly that it took the corners off a box, and now the box rolls.
x_file_tool.lore.epic: Filed the rough edges off every chair in the workshop, and now nobody can stop sliding off them.
x_file_tool.lore.legendary: Filed a rocky mountain path so smooth that the goats now use it as a slide.

x_garden_hose.lore.epic: Sprayed so wildly when the tap went on that it washed the car, the windows and a very surprised postman.
x_garden_hose.lore.legendary: Stretched all the way to the park in a drought, and the ducks sent it a thank-you feather.

x_golf_club.lore.legendary: Hit a ball so hard that it went right round the world and dropped into the hole from behind, a week late.

x_golf_tee.lore.epic: Was pushed so deep into the ground that it grew roots, and the first hole now has a very small tree.
x_golf_tee.lore.legendary: Launched a ball so high that it came down a week later in the hole, and the golfer counted it.

x_gutter.lore.legendary: Caught so much rain in one storm that it became the highest pond in town, with its own duck.

x_hacksaw_blade.lore.common: Loses its teeth one by one, so every cut ends with a toothless squeak.
x_hacksaw_blade.lore.epic: Cut the bike-shed lock so fast that every bike inside rolled out and went for a ride on its own.
x_hacksaw_blade.lore.legendary: Cut through a garden gate lock stuck for ten years, and the gate swung open and ran off down the lane.

x_hose_reel.lore.rare: Winds itself up while someone is still holding the end, and drags them across the patio.

x_hurling_stick.lore.legendary: Scored a point from so far out that the ball landed in the next county, and that county still counts it.

x_ice_axe.lore.epic: Struck a frozen waterfall so hard that the whole waterfall unfroze at once and soaked the climbing team.
x_ice_axe.lore.legendary: Hooked a passing cloud on a mountain top and pulled it down, and the climbers had a snowball fight inside it.

x_javelin.lore.epic: Flew so far at sports day that it landed in the egg-and-spoon race, and won it.

x_jump_rope.lore.epic: Was turned so fast in the playground that a passing pigeon caught the rhythm and skipped along all lunchtime.

x_kick_pad.lore.epic: Took so many kicks at the grading that its stuffing flew out, and the hall looked like a snow globe.
x_kick_pad.lore.legendary: Took one kick so perfectly that it flew across the hall into the lost property box, where it is still sulking.

x_lacrosse_stick.lore.legendary: Caught a ball thrown from the far end of the field, then a frisbee, then a passing seagull's lunch.

x_led_strip.lore.legendary: Glowed so brightly purple that a passing aeroplane flashed back, and the two now chat every evening.

x_nail.lore.epic: Held up every picture in the new house so straight that the house itself looked crooked by comparison.
x_nail.lore.legendary: Held up a painting so heavy that the wall gave up first, and the nail and the painting still hang there on their own.

x_nut.lore.epic: Got stuck on the wrong bolt and turned so stubbornly that the whole workbench turned round instead.
x_nut.lore.legendary: Held a wheel on so firmly that the bike fell apart around it, and the wheel rolled all the way home alone.

x_paint_roller.lore.legendary: Painted the school hall in one night, and the children came back to find even the piano was sky blue.

x_palette.lore.legendary: Mixed a colour so new that the rainbow came down to look at it and took it home.

x_peeler.lore.rare: Peels anything it touches, so the potato, the apple and the label on the jam jar all came out bare.
x_peeler.lore.epic: Peeled so many potatoes for Sunday lunch that the peelings made a hill in the garden, and the hens climbed it for the view.
x_peeler.lore.legendary: Peeled the wallpaper off a whole house by mistake, and found a secret door behind it.

x_pickaxe.lore.epic: Struck one rock so hard that the whole hillside rang like a bell, and the sheep on top all stood up at once.

x_pressure_washer.lore.rare: Blasts so hard that it washed the paint off the fence along with the moss, and the fence is now grey and furious.

x_punching_bag.lore.epic: Was punched so hard that it swung up and rang the bell for the next round all by itself.
x_punching_bag.lore.legendary: Was punched so often that it learned to dodge, and nobody in the gym has landed a punch since March.

x_rope.lore.epic: Pulled a stuck tractor out of the mud, and the tractor was so grateful that it followed the rope home.
x_rope.lore.legendary: Swung a whole class across the school pond one by one, and only the teacher fell in.

x_rowing_machine.lore.epic: Whooshed so hard at the gym that every towel in the room blew into one pile, with the instructor underneath.
x_rowing_machine.lore.legendary: Rowed so hard one morning that the garage slid down the drive into the pond, and finally got to float.

x_screw.lore.rare: Turns itself in a little deeper every night, so the picture creeps up the wall a centimetre a week.

x_shed.lore.rare: Locks itself whenever someone needs the lawnmower, and opens only for the cat.
x_shed.lore.legendary: Held so much junk that the family found their old car in it, with the picnic still in the boot.

x_skipping_rope.lore.epic: Was skipped so hard at the skipathon that the playground got a groove, and every puddle there is now rope-shaped.
x_skipping_rope.lore.legendary: Skipped so fast that it tied itself into a bow round its owner, who arrived at the party already wrapped.

x_sledge.lore.rare: Thumps the ground so hard that every worm in the garden comes up to see who is there.
x_sledge.lore.legendary: Hit the ground so hard that a mole popped up three gardens away, holding its ears.

x_snow_shovel.lore.rare: Throws snow so far that it builds a snowman in next door's garden every time.
x_snow_shovel.lore.legendary: Cleared the village lane so fast that the snowplough found nothing to do and went home in a sulk.

x_string_lights.lore.common: Hangs perfectly straight for an hour, then droops in the middle like a sleepy smile.
x_string_lights.lore.uncommon: Has one bulb that blinks out of time with the others, like a dancer who missed the start.
x_string_lights.lore.epic: Was strung across the street for the summer fair, and the moths held their own fair underneath.

x_treadmill.lore.epic: Was set so fast at rush hour that its runner shot off the back into the yoga mats, and the class made it a new pose.
x_treadmill.lore.legendary: Ran so fast once that the belt went backwards in time, and everyone went home before they had arrived.

x_trowel.lore.epic: Dug so many holes on planting day that the squirrels took it for a buffet and buried their nuts in every one.
x_trowel.lore.legendary: Planted a thousand bulbs in one autumn, all upside down, and in spring the tulips came up in Australia.

x_usb_cable.lore.legendary: Was plugged in upside down so confidently that the socket turned itself round to fit.

x_utility_knife.lore.common: Gets buried under everything in the toolbox, so the grown-ups tip the whole box out to find it.
x_utility_knife.lore.legendary: Cut the ribbon at the new library so neatly that the ribbon tied itself back up and asked to do it again.

x_vise.lore.epic: Held every project in woodwork class at once, and when the bell rang it refused to let anyone take theirs home.
x_vise.lore.legendary: Held a plank so firmly through a gale that the workshop blew away and the plank stayed exactly where it was.

x_washer.lore.common: Gets stuck on your finger like a ring, and everyone asks when the wedding is.
x_washer.lore.epic: Fell down the plughole and rattled through the pipes so loudly that the whole street called a plumber.
x_washer.lore.legendary: Fitted so snugly into the town fountain that the fountain stopped, and the pigeons had to queue for baths elsewhere.

x_yarn.lore.epic: Unravelled so far that one end was found at the school gates, and the children followed it home like a treasure hunt.
x_yarn.lore.legendary: Knitted itself into a scarf while nobody was looking, and the scarf has gone off on its own adventures.
